messages:
Alex: Quick sync — we need to lock the model-introspection/discovery surface for the roadmap. Customers are asking for per-model tool whitelists, advertised JSON output schemas, streaming for function-calls, and explicit token limits. Need to define MVP vs GA, rollout criteria, and how per-tenant overrides look.

Priya: TL;DR proposal for MVP -> GA:
- Endpoint: GET /models/:id/discover
- Response fields: supported_capabilities (list), tools (list with name/id/input_schema/auth_requirements), streaming_supported (bool), max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens
- MVP: streaming_supported=false, tools include schema only, no per-tenant overrides exposed in API (but stored internally)
- GA: streaming_supported=true, per-tenant overrides via Admin API, SDK support, migration guide

Jon: Add versioning: include spec_version and spec_hash so clients can detect changes. Also include compatibility_level ("strict"|"lenient") so runtimes can decide to reject or coerce inputs. We should build a conformance test harness that runs sample prompts + tool-calls.

Maya: From CS — priorities from customers:
- Enterprise: per-org tool whitelist enforced at routing + audit logs for every tool invocation
- Token limits: customers want transparent headers (X-Model-Max-Tokens, X-Model-Remaining) so apps can surface correct UI
- Need migration guidance for models that reduce max_output_tokens mid-contract

Alex: Rollout & acceptance criteria idea:
1) Spec + OpenAPI fragment published and linted
2) SDKs (JS/Python) can parse discover response and enforce local limits
3) Canary with Redwood Dedicated for 2 pilot customers for 2 weeks
4) Error rate delta <= +2% vs baseline for discovery calls; discovery latency p50 < 200ms
5) Security: per-tenant overrides encrypted (KMS) + audit logs enabled
6) Telemetry: metrics for tool usage, streaming sessions, truncated outputs
GA gated on 3 paying orgs using the feature for 30 days with stable metrics

Priya: Agreed. API shape example (OpenAPI fragment will follow) — include fallback_models so orchestrator can route cheaper variant:

{
  "model_id": "redwood-xx",
  "spec_version": "2026-03-01",
  "capabilities": ["chat","functions","streaming"],
  "tools": [
    {"id":"search","name":"product-search","input_schema":"{...}","auth":"token"}
  ],
  "streaming_supported": true,
  "max_context_tokens": 4096,
  "max_output_tokens": 1024,
  "fallback_models": ["redwood-xx-quant"]
}

Jon: Also add privacy flags: privacy_preserving (bool) and kms_required (bool) so private deployments can advertise constraints. And include a conformance_url pointing to the test harness endpoint.

Maya: Add acceptance item: Console needs a sample UI for per-org tool whitelist management before GA. CS will collect top-5 enterprise asks and share by next Wed.

Alex: Next steps & owners:
- Priya: draft full OpenAPI fragment + example responses by EOD Friday
- Jon: conformance tests spec + initial harness repo list by next Tue
- Maya: top-5 customer asks + migration cases by next Wed
- Alex: schedule 30-min decision sync Tues 10am PT

Priya: :thumbsup: will start the OpenAPI fragment and include examples for streaming vs non-streaming flows.

InfraBot: deploy-bot: created channel test-run-1830 for canary customers
